# Etsy lays off 12% of staff amid restructuring Online marketplace Etsy is laying off 12% of its total workforce, equivalent to 220 employees, amid a restructuring, according to reports\. Etsy said in a US Securities and Exchange Commission filing earlier this week \(5 August\) that the restructuring hopes to “improve coordination and speed of decision making”\. Etsy CEO Kruti Patel Goyal, who took the helm on 1 January this year, said in an email sent to employees, seen by *Reuters*, that the job cuts would mostly impact workers across product and engineering departments\. Goyal added that the job cuts “weren’t driven by artificial intelligence \(AI\)”\. Impacted staff will receive “at least 16 weeks of severance pay”, as well as additional pay based on the length of their tenure\. Those affected will also receive healthcare support for “up to 12 months”, alongside other benefits\. Drapers has reached out to Etsy for comment\. This comes after Etsy agreed to sell secondhand marketplace Depop to Ebay for $1\.2 billion \(£888m\) in February\. Ebay’s acquisition of the platform was completed on 30 July, as reported earlier this week\.
